d2 and d10 report lower ranges (~55–76 million), while d3 and d4 present higher spans up to >100 million; d6 offers an intermediate 50–90 million band.

The evidence clusters into two broad camps: lower-to-mid estimates around 55–76 million and higher estimates extending to >100 million. These differences stem from divergent assumptions about census coverage, inclusion of non-citizens, and interpolation from fragmentary data. No single snippet decisively resolves the range, but together they show the scholarly disagreement.

The cited sources collectively indicate that modern estimates for the empire’s population at its height vary widely, typically between roughly 55 million and more than 100 million, with many mid-range figures clustering around 70–75 million [d2,d3,d4,d6,d10].
